caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a young girl standing against a plain, light background. She wears a voluminous, peach-colored dress with puffed sleeves and a gathered bodice. The dress has decorative black patterns along the neckline, waist, and lower hemline. Underneath the dress, she has long, white or very light blue sleeves covering her arms. She has light blue stockings and matching light blue shoes with bows on the toes. Her dark hair is parted in the center and styled in ringlets on either side of her face. The overall composition places the girl centrally on the page with no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Doll - "Rachel"
